name: groups
description: Groups in a body, which add no depth to the DOM (engine §9).

name: groups-syntax-later
description: Groups, and a syntax error after them.

name: optionals
description: Optionals, an expression nested too deep.

name: optionals-error-later
description: Optionals beyond the depth limit, followed by a valid unresolved constant. The depth error stands at the first rule (engine §9.3).

name: term-parens
description: Parentheses around a tag in a tag term (engine §9).

name: condition-parens
description: Parentheses around a condition (engine §9).

name: negations
description: Negations of a presence test (engine §9).

name: implications
description: Conditions joined by ⟹, which group to the right (engine §9).

name: guards
description: Guards in a row before a tag term (engine §9).

name: unions
description: Unions, each in parentheses inside the one before (engine §9).

name: any-groups
description: Conditions joined by ∨, each group in parentheses inside the one before, which the reader folds into one (engine §9).

name: long-name
description: A rule name of many characters, which the lexical stage reads as one token.

name: long-capture
description: A capture name of many characters (engine §9).

name: long-guard
description: A guard name of many characters.

name: long-tag
description: A tag literal of many characters in a tag term (engine §9).

name: long-comment
description: A comment of many characters.

name: comment-of-openers
description: A comment that holds many quotes, comment openers and prefixes, each of which could begin a token.

name: long-string
description: A string of many characters in a test.

name: string-of-dollar-forms
description: A plain string contains many dollar forms without decoding them (engine §9.1).

name: repeated-capture-name
description: The same capture name at every level of nested sequences, which the check of repeated captures reports. Each capture is marked as repeated once, not again at each level above it (engine §9).
